### [`fight_background`](../../../../src/data/fight_background.asm#L6) `$AF30-$AF4F`

*variable*

Clean copy of the fight area: 8 character rows of 320 bytes (bitmap rows 14-21), $af30-$b92f.

<a id="bg_strip0"></a>
### [`bg_strip0`](../../../../src/data/fight_background.asm#L9) `$AF50-$B08F`

*variable*

Columns 4-35 of bitmap row 14+k, at $af50+320k. $8aef fills them, $8b25 copies them to the work bitmap.

- **Read by:** [`restore_work_bitmap`](../screen/fight_area.md#restore_work_bitmap)
